title: From a 2D Corner Obstruction to 3D and d-Dimensional Ferrers Diagram Bijections: Tableau Positivity and the Kanade-Russell I_1 Identity
author: Christopher Yamba
originating_insight_attribution: Christopher Yamba's original geometric insight and suggestion to resolve the planar 2D corner-slide obstruction by sliding cells into a 3D Ferrers diagram where entries strictly descend along the 3rd axis, and extending the construction to d > 3 dimensions, cracked both the height-3 corner-slide collision / multi-sector Dual Jacobi-Trudi cancellation (n = 5, 6) and the a >= 3 cone and universal 3D octant operator decomposition for the Kanade-Russell I_1 bijection (0 <= N <= 40).
